from flask import Flask, request
import ldap3

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.post("/login")
def login():
    username = request.form["username"]
    password = request.form["password"]
    server = ldap3.Server("ldap.internal", 389)
    with ldap3.Connection(server, user="cn=svc,dc=x", password="pw", auto_bind=True) as conn:
        ldfilt = f"(&(objectClass=Person)(uid={username}))"
        conn.search("dc=example,dc=com", ldfilt, attributes=["memberOf"])
    return {"ok": True}

notes.probe:
from flask import Flask, request
import paramiko

app = Flask(__name__)
SAVE = "/var/lib/configs"

def config_path(service, server_ip):
    return f"{SAVE}/{server_ip}-{service}.cfg"

@app.post("/<service>/show")
def show(service):
    server_ip = request.json.get("serv")
    cfg = config_path(service, server_ip)
    client = paramiko.SSHClient()
    client.connect(server_ip)
    sftp = client.open_sftp()
    with sftp.open(cfg, "rb") as fh:
        return fh.read()
